name: Suspend Agent
description: Manually suspends an agent until explicitly resumed, recording who stopped it and an optional reason. A repeated stop replaces that record. A transition in flight is cancelled; state, sessions and history are preserved.

agentId.description: Agent reference: a bare name for the caller's agent, g/<id>, /g/<id>, or <ownerDID>/g/<id>

reason.description: Why the agent is being stopped, recorded with at most 512 characters

by.description: Actual caller DID, including through sudo
